Flame03: raw TGA sequence sampled to 128 frames, WebP 2048x1920.
FireBall01: 64 frames, WebP 1024x1024.
Approved fire-study B settings: strength 1.6, speed 1.4, ember density 1.6.
Local game integration, 2026-11-12. Original archive and build scripts retained in fire-study.
